title: sideritis clandestina var. cyllenea
intro: Sideritis clandestina var. cyllenea, commonly known as Cretan mountain tea or Cretan ironwort, is a plant species within the genus Sideritis, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis clandestina var. cyllenea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Research has identified the presence of ursolic acid, a major bioactive compound in this plant, which is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
